LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTreasuryUnavailable: This House no longer has enough silver to honour the proposal. Adjust the requested amount.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploNoFactions: No other Houses are known to you yet.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploReducedPanel: This is not a House of Westeros, so oaths, marriages and territorial terms are unavailable. War, peace and payments still apply.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploFoundationNote: Territorial NPC diplomacy and intrigue remain future work.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploFamilyNone: No kin are known to your House.
LanguageData.ARIO_FamilyTreeNavigation: Mouse wheel: zoom ({0}%). Left-drag empty space: pan. Click a card to inspect.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploExhaustionExplanation: Exhaustion rises the longer a war lasts and jumps after battles, raids and lost holdings. A tired enemy accepts harsher peace terms.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploWarWarning: Declaring war needs no agreement. Without a standing grievance it costs House Integrity, and breaking a sworn bond costs far more.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploOathExplanation: Swear fealty to {0}. Your House Head takes the title of Landed Knight, and they become your liege — owed taxes and service, but bound to aid you.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploDemandOathExplanation: Demand that {0} bend the knee. A House only submits to a clearly stronger neighbour, or one it is too weary to refuse.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploAlreadySworn: Your House is already sworn to {0}. Only one liege may be served at a time.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploCannotSwear: Your House cannot swear fealty to this House right now.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploCannotDemandOath: This House cannot be made your vassal right now.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLiegeNote: {0} is your liege. They may call your banners, demand taxes and request supplies, and may send aid when your holdings are attacked.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploVassalNote: {0} is your vassal. They owe you taxes, supplies and military service.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTaxBody: Collectors from your liege {0} have arrived at your settlement. They require {1} {2}, handed over in person.\n\nThey will wait about two days. Paying strengthens your standing. Refusing will be remembered, and refusing repeatedly will be remembered longer.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTaxPaid: Your taxes to {0} have been paid.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTaxNoCollectors: {0}'s collectors are not here to receive payment.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTaxCollectorsLeft: {0}'s collectors left your settlement empty-handed. Your standing has suffered.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTaxPostponed: {0} grants your House three more days.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTaxRefused: You have refused {0}'s collectors. Your standing has suffered.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploVassalPaid: {0} has delivered {1} silver in vassal dues.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploVassalPartyBody: Your vassal {0} has sent envoys to your settlement bearing {1} silver in dues. They will seek out one of your colonists to hand it over.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploPartyKilledBody: Members of {0}'s party died at your settlement. Word of it will travel, and your House Integrity and standing have both suffered badly.\n\nTheir errand is abandoned. They will send another party in about {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploPartyHurtBody: Members of {0}'s party were wounded at your settlement. A House that cannot keep its guests whole is not soon trusted, and your standing has suffered.\n\nTheir errand is abandoned. They will send another party in about {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerBody: Your liege {0} commands your House to send {1} levies and a commander to war. You have {2} days to answer.\n\nLead a mustered force to a physical battle camp, or send an abstract holding captain and troops for a three-day autoresolved campaign. Refusal, silence or arriving late breaks your obligation.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerAuto: Send the banners under a captain
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerNoSite: No suitable rally site can be found on {0}'s campaign front.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerRallyBody: Muster at least {1} tracked levies and one free colonist commander, form a caravan, and take them to {0}'s campaign camp within {2} days. The camp follows the war front, not your home. Right-click it and choose the feudal battle option.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerNotEnough: Your holdings cannot presently commit {0} levies.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerSent: {0} levies have departed under a holding captain to answer {1}'s call.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerNeedLevies: requires {0} tracked levies; this caravan has {1}
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerInspect: Enemy force: about {0}\nBring the demanded tracked levies and a free colonist commander.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerWonBody: Your force prevailed in {0}'s war. {1} levies were lost. Your liege and the realm will remember that your banners answered.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerLostBody: Your force was defeated while serving {0}. {1} levies were lost, but your House still answered its oath.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerIgnored: Your House gave no answer when {0} called its banners.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerRefused: Your House refused {0}'s call to war.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerLate: Your force failed to reach {0}'s battle camp in time.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerSiteLost: {0}'s battle camp is no longer reachable.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerPending: Banner call: {0} levies requested; answer within {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerAutoStatus: Banner campaign: {0} levies away; resolves in {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerManualStatus: Banner campaign: bring {0} levies and a commander to the camp within {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploBannerNext: Next possible banner call in about {0}.
LanguageData.ARIO_LiegeBattleSizeUnavailable: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] Larger banner-call battles could not be enabled; banner calls keep their original sizes: {0}
LanguageData.ARIO_BannerCampPointerTip: {0} is off screen. Click to jump to it.
LanguageData.ARIO_BannerCampBeaconUnavailable: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] The battle-camp world-map beacon is unavailable; the camp keeps its normal icon: {0}
LanguageData.ARIO_BannerBattleLiegeHostArrived: {0} has sent {1} soldiers to stand with your banners on the west of the field. The enemy host is mustering in the east; the lines will meet in the middle.
LanguageData.ARIO_BannerBattleLiegeHostUnavailable: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] {0}'s host could not join the battle camp; you fight with your own force only: {1}
LanguageData.ARIO_BannerBattleLayoutUnavailable: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] The battle camp's eastern muster point could not be applied; the enemy uses Core's random edge.
LanguageData.ARIO_LiegeBattleLevyCapUnavailable: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] The banner-call levy limit could not be raised; your liege still asks for at most six levies. Battle camps still field the larger enemy force.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploSupplyBody: Your liege {0} requires {1} {2} delivered by caravan to {3}. If accepted, the caravan must arrive within {4} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploSupplyAccepted: Load {0} {1} into a caravan and deliver it to {2} before the deadline.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploSupplyRefused: Your House refused or ignored {0}'s request for supplies.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploSupplyLate: Your House promised supplies to {0}, but failed to deliver them in time.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploSupplyDeliveredBody: Your caravan delivered {0} {1} to {2}. Your liege approves of your faithful service.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploSupplyNext: Next possible supply request in about {0}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLiegeVisitBody: {0}, head of {1}, has arrived with an entourage for a stay of about {2} days. Their safety, health, comfort and access to beds will shape how the visit is remembered.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLiegeVisitGreat: {0} leaves greatly pleased with your hospitality. The visit earned a score of {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLiegeVisitFair: {0} found your hospitality adequate. The visit earned a score of {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLiegeVisitPoor: {0} leaves displeased by the state of your hospitality. The visit earned a score of {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploVisitInProgress: Your liege's visit has about {0} remaining.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploVisitNext: Next possible liege visit in about {0}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploDefenseAidBody: Your liege {0} has promised {1} fighters to help defend {2}. They strengthen autoresolve immediately, or will appear physically on a manual defense map.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploAidRecovered: Liege reinforcements could not enter safely. Their aid promise was cancelled without penalty.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploRecoveredBody: An errand involving {0} could not continue safely. Any committed holding troops were returned, stale visitors and targets were released, and no penalty was applied. The obligation may be attempted again in about {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploActionRecovered: The diplomatic action could not finish safely. Its partial state was cleared without applying it twice.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploNoLandToGive: You hold no settled, idle holding to hand over. Holdings under construction, under attack, rebuilding or with levies in the field cannot change hands.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploNoLandToTake: This House holds no settled village, town or garrison you could ask for.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploHoldingUnavailable: That holding can no longer change hands. Choose another.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploConfirmGiveLand: If they accept, {0} passes permanently to {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploConfirmTakeLand: If they accept, {0} passes permanently from {1} to your House.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTerritoryGivenBody: {0} now answers to {1}. Its smallfolk, garrison and buildings pass with it, and its taxes no longer come to your House.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTerritoryTakenBody: {0} has been ceded by {1} and now answers to your House. Part of its garrison followed its old lord home, and it pays no taxes while it settles under your banner.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploProposeTrade: Propose a trade pact (caravan every {0} days)
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploProposeTradeTip: A standing agreement to trade. While it holds, this House sends a real trade caravan to your settlement on the schedule you set, and steady dealings slowly warm the relationship. A frequent schedule is a burden on them and much harder to agree to than a rare one. War ends the pact at once, with no blame on either side.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTradePactBody: Your House and {0} have agreed to trade. Their caravans will visit your settlement every {1} days while the pact holds, and steady custom will slowly warm relations between you.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTradePactActive: Trade pact in force: a caravan every {0} days. The next is due in {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTradePactNone: No trade pact is in force.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTradePactEndConfirm: End your trade pact with {0}? Walking away from a standing agreement costs your House a little of its name.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTradePactEnded: Your trade pact with {0} has ended.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyAvailable: Your holdings can spare {0} soldiers right now. Lent soldiers leave their holding's garrison and workforce for the whole term.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyNone: No levy service is in force.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyServing: {0} of your levies serve {1}. They return in {2}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyGarrison: {0} of {1}'s soldiers garrison your holdings. They leave in {2}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyBusy: A levy service agreement with {0} is already in force.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyNoTroops: Your holdings cannot spare that many soldiers.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyNoRoom: Your holdings have no room to garrison hired soldiers.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevySentBody: {0} of your levies now serve {1}. Their holdings lose that strength and workforce for the term, and they are due home in {2}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyHiredBody: {0} soldiers of {1} have taken up garrison in your holdings, strengthening their defense. They depart in {2}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyReturnedBody: {0} of your levies have come home from service with {1}. {2} did not return. Honouring the term has strengthened your House's name.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploLevyDeparted: {0} of {1}'s soldiers have left your holdings.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploConfirmWar: Declare war on {0}?\n\nThis turns them hostile immediately and cannot be taken back without a negotiated peace.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploCooldown: {0} will not hear another proposal for {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploNotEnoughSilver: Your keep does not hold {0} silver.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploWarDeclaredBody: Your House has declared war on {0}. Their holdings are now open to attack, and their allies may answer the call.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploWarUnjustifiedBody: Your House has declared war on {0} without a standing grievance. The realm judges the act harshly and your House Integrity has suffered.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploPeaceBody: Your House and {0} have come to terms. The war is over and relations return to neutral.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploOathSwornBody: Your House has sworn fealty to {0}. Your House Head is now a Landed Knight in their service. They may call your banners and collect taxes, and may answer when your holdings are threatened.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploVassalBody: {0} has bent the knee to your House. They owe you taxes, supplies and service in war.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploOathBrokenBody: Your House has turned on {0}, a House bound to yours by oath. The realm will not soon forget it, and your House Integrity has fallen sharply.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTributeMissed: Your keep could not pay {1} silver in tribute to {0}. House Integrity has suffered.
LanguageData.ARIO_DiploTributeCancelled: {0} has torn up your tribute agreement after repeated missed payments.
